지뢰찾기 판이다. 열린 칸에는 지뢰가 없고, 열린 칸에 적힌 숫자는 그: This is a Minesweeper board. Opened cells have no mines, and the number written on an opened cell is the number of cells with a mine among the 8 cells surrounding that cell (above, below, to the left, to the right, and the four diagonal cells). Outside the board is not counted.

This is a Minesweeper board. Opened cells have no mines, and the number written on an opened cell is the number of cells with a mine among the 4 cells above, below, to the left, and to the right of that cell. Diagonal cells are not counted. Outside the board is not counted.
판은 행 A~, 열 1~로 적는다. \"*\"는 지뢰, \".\"은 지뢰: The board is written with rows starting from A and columns starting from 1. "*" is a mine, and "." is a cell with no mine. A coordinate is written by joining the row and the column, as in "B2".
지뢰가 없는 D2 칸에 적힐 숫자는?: What number would be written on cell D2, which has no mine?
지뢰가 없는 B2 칸에 적힐 숫자는?: What number would be written on cell B2, which has no mine?
지뢰가 없는 B4 칸에 적힐 숫자는?: What number would be written on cell B4, which has no mine?
판은 행 A~, 열 1~로 적는다. 숫자는 열린 칸, \"?\"는 아직: The board is written with rows starting from A and columns starting from 1. A number is an opened cell, and "?" is a cell not yet opened. A coordinate is written by joining the row and the column, as in "B2". The total number of mines on the board is not given.
아직 열지 않은 칸 가운데 지뢰가 없다고 확실히 말할 수 있는 칸은?: Among the cells not yet opened, which cell can be said for certain to have no mine?
A4 — 맞닿은 열린 칸의 숫자: B4=1, B5=1: A4 — numbers on the adjacent opened cells: B4=1, B5=1
B1 — 맞닿은 열린 칸의 숫자: C1=1, C2=2: B1 — numbers on the adjacent opened cells: C1=1, C2=2
D3 — 맞닿은 열린 칸의 숫자: C2=2, D4=2: D3 — numbers on the adjacent opened cells: C2=2, D4=2
